title: The Vanishing Developer
subtitle: Round 3 — AI Chaos Room
summary: A brilliant developer disappears the night before launching her revolutionary AI product 'NEXUS'. The system has secrets. The team has motives. Can you uncover the truth before the stolen work is released?

suspects.name: Arjun Kapoor
suspects.bio: Ambitious. Under massive pressure from venture investors. Had full admin access.
suspects.alibi: Claims he was in late-night investor status calls in Conference Room A.
suspects.motive: Stole the NEXUS model weights and silenced Mira when she threatened to expose its unaligned predictive design.

suspects.name: Riya Patel
suspects.bio: Brilliant but overlooked. Recently passed over for promotion.
suspects.alibi: Working remotely from home IP at 01:12 AM.

suspects.name: Rahul Dev
suspects.bio: Quiet, sarcastic. Had constant ethical conflicts with Mira regarding model guardrails.
suspects.motive: Disagreements over AI safety guardrail strictness.

suspects.name: Vikram Malhotra
suspects.bio: Pushed aggressively for early launch. Facing huge financial losses if delayed.
suspects.motive: Demanded launch regardless of safety warnings.

evidence.title: System Prompt Draft (Recovered)
Internal Chat Log (Snippet)
evidence.content:
Mira: I don't think we should launch this yet.
Arjun (CTO): Investors won't wait forever.
Riya: If we delay, someone else will release it.
Mira: At what cost?
Dev (Rahul): We all have costs. Don't be naive.
Mira: I've locked access to the core model.
Arjun: Bold move. Hope you know what that means.

'Trust no one. Especially the ones with everything to gain.'
Note: Her laptop was wiped. But not perfectly. Don't build a monster and call it progress. - M.S.
